history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian boy with short black hair and glasses is sitting on a curved, metallic bench in an indoor setting that resembles a modern mall or atrium. He is wearing a light blue and white striped short-sleeved button-up shirt, black shorts, white socks with black Nike logos, and black sneakers. His right hand is behind his head, and he is holding a dark-colored smartphone in his left hand.

The background features lush, artificial greenery, including a large tree with many leaves and smaller leafy plants. Behind the plants, there's a contemporary architectural element with a curved, metallic facade and a dark ceiling with exposed ducts and lighting fixtures. The floor is a speckled terrazzo. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a calm and relaxed atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by natural greens, cool metallic grays, and the blue and white of the boy's shirt, with pops of black from his clothing and accessories. The overall mood is casual and contemplative.
